source: Regesten der Pfalzgrafen am Rhein, Band II, Nr. 6126
entries.german: 1410 jan. 20 o. 0. Hans von Rosenberg und seine gattin Else Marschalkin von Bappenheim verkaufen um 145 fl. an herrn Wylhelm unssers hrn. des römischen konigs artzet, ihr hus, hoffreyde und gesehs mit dem garten daran gelegen ... daz gelegen ist zu Heydelberg für dem obern tore uff dem Necker an Elachhensels garten. (Vgl. april 23.)
entries.english: 1410 January 20, place not stated. Hans von Rosenberg and his wife Else Marschalkin von Bappenheim sell their house, courtyard, and associated property with its garden, located in Heidelberg outside the Upper Gate on the Neckar beside Elachhensel’s garden, to Lord Wilhelm, physician to our lord the Roman King, for 145 florins. (See April 23.)

facts.content: sold, with his wife Else Marschalkin von Bappenheim, their house, courtyard, and associated property with its garden in Heidelberg to Wilhelm, the Roman king’s physician, for 145 florins.
